description: Source file implementing unique operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including graph building, caching, and specialized unique functions.

classes.name: UniqueCachedGraph
classes.description: Cache structure for MPS graph used in unique operations, holding tensors for input, output, inverse indices, counts, and length.

methods.name: getUniqueKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for caching based on tensor dtype, shape, and operation parameters.

methods.name: buildUniqueGraph
methods.description: Constructs the MPS graph for performing unique operation, handling sorting, flattening, and tensor comparisons.

methods.name: getUniqueGraph
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached UniqueCachedGraph for given tensor and operation parameters.

methods.name: runUniqueGraph
methods.description: Executes the MPS graph for the unique operation with provided input and output tensors.

methods.name: _unique_impl_mps
methods.description: Main implementation for unique operation on MPS backend, managing tensor shapes, caching, and invoking graph execution.

methods.name: castToMPS
methods.description: Converts output tensors to MPS device.

methods.name: unique_consecutive_mps
methods.description: Performs unique operation on a tensor with consecutive elements, returning unique values, inverse indices, and counts.

methods.name: unique_dim_consecutive_mps
methods.description: Performs unique on a specific dimension with consecutive elements.

methods.name: _unique2_mps
methods.description: Performs unique operation with sorting, returning unique values, inverse indices, and counts.

methods.name: lexsort_rows_perm_mps
methods.description: Computes permutation indices to lexicographically sort the rows of a 2D tensor.

methods.name: unique_dim_sorted_mps_impl
methods.description: Implementation for unique on a specific dimension with sorted input, returning unique slices, inverse indices, and counts.

methods.name: unique_dim_mps
methods.description: Wrapper for unique_dim_sorted_mps_impl, for specific dimension operation.
